name: 22066 · Great Falls, VA
findings: ZIP 22066 (Great Falls) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22066 (Great Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22066 (Great Falls) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
